fib: ______ is the wind direction most often observed during a given time period.
prevailing wind
The prevailing wind is the wind direction most often observed during a given time period.
______ is one of the more important gases responsible for the greenhouse effect.
Carbon dioxide
Carbon dioxide is one of the more important gases responsible for the greenhouse effect.
______ is the rate at which biomass is produced per unit area by plants, expressed in either units of energy [joules/(m2)(day)] or dry organic matter [kg/(m2)(year)].
Primary productivity of a community
Primary productivity of a community is the rate at which biomass is produced per unit area by plants, expressed in either units of energy [joules/(m2)(day)] or dry organic matter [kg/(m2)(year)].
______ are those limited by heat energy and water like the deserts and the polar tundra.
least productive ecosystems
The least productive ecosystems are those limited by heat energy and water like the deserts and the polar tundra.
______ is a physical barrier to plant root growth.
permafrost line
The permafrost line is a physical barrier to plant root growth.
______ is the measurable increase in the average temperature of earth's atmosphere, oceans and landmasses.
Climate change
Climate change is the measurable increase in the average temperature of earth's atmosphere, oceans and landmasses.
______ is a mixture of gases of which nitrogen is the most abundant followed by oxygen, water, argon, carbon dioxide, neon, helium, methane, hydrogen, nitrous oxide and ozone.
atmosphere
The atmosphere is a mixture of gases of which nitrogen is the most abundant followed by oxygen, water, argon, carbon dioxide, neon, helium, methane, hydrogen, nitrous oxide and ozone.
______ is a very strong greenhouse gas.
Methane
Methane is a very strong greenhouse gas.
______ is a region of concentration of the ozone molecule (O3) in the earth's atmosphere.
ozone layer
The ozone layer is a region of concentration of the ozone molecule (O3) in the earth's atmosphere.
______ is a mixture of gases that composes which atmosphere that surrounding the earth.
Air
Air is a mixture of gases that composes which atmosphere that surrounding the earth.
______ is any form of water (either liquid or solid) that falls from the atmosphere and reaches the ground, such as rain, snow, or hail.
Precipitation
Precipitation is any form of water (either liquid or solid) that falls from the atmosphere and reaches the ground, such as rain, snow, or hail.
______ refers to the air's water vapor content.
Humidity
Humidity refers to the air's water vapor content.
______ are those in which light energy causes a chemical process, and photoelectric processes involve a direct conversion of radiation to electrical energy like the solar inverters.
Photochemical processes
Photochemical processes are those in which light energy causes a chemical process, and photoelectric processes involve a direct conversion of radiation to electrical energy like the solar inverters.
______ can be defined as a horizontal movement of seawater at the ocean's surface.
ocean current
An ocean current can be defined as a horizontal movement of seawater at the ocean's surface.
______ is composed of a range of radiant energies known as the solar spectrum, which includes visible light, infrared light, gamma rays, X rays, and ultraviolet light.
Sunlight
Sunlight is composed of a range of radiant energies known as the solar spectrum, which includes visible light, infrared light, gamma rays, X rays, and ultraviolet light.
______ is known as the ozone layer and shields life on earth from the sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation, which can cause cancer and other damage to plants and animals.
Ozone in the upper atmosphere
Ozone in the upper atmosphere is known as the ozone layer and shields life on earth from the sun's harmful ultraviolet radiation, which can cause cancer and other damage to plants and animals.
______ are a response of the atmosphere and ocean to the flow of energy from the tropics to Polar Regions.
Large ocean currents
Large ocean currents are a response of the atmosphere and ocean to the flow of energy from the tropics to Polar Regions.
______ can be defined as all the external factors affecting an organism.
Environment on the other hand
Environment on the other hand can be defined as all the external factors affecting an organism.
______ is a directional non-seasonal cumulative change in the types of plant species that occupy a given area through time.
Succession
Succession is a directional non-seasonal cumulative change in the types of plant species that occupy a given area through time.
______ is the sole source of heat for the earth's atmosphere.
sun
The sun is the sole source of heat for the earth's atmosphere.
